compromised_account.name: Compromised Account Response
compromised_account.description: Respond to a suspected compromised user account.

steps.impact: User cannot log in. All active sessions will be terminated on next check.
steps.risk: Business disruption if wrong user targeted.

steps.impact: All OAuth tokens and session cookies invalidated immediately.
steps.risk: Low. User re-authenticates on next access.

steps.impact: IP blocked at perimeter firewall for 72 hours.
steps.risk: May block shared NAT; review IP reputation before confirming.

malware_host.name: Malware Host Containment
malware_host.description: Isolate and remediate a host with confirmed malware activity.

steps.impact: Host removed from network. Users lose access. Forensic collection triggered.
steps.risk: High operational impact if production system.

steps.impact: Malicious process terminated. May trigger cleanup routine if rootkit present.
steps.risk: Medium. Process termination may cause data loss if legitimate app co-located.

steps.impact: C2 IP blocked at perimeter firewall for 72 hours.
steps.risk: Low. IP is external C2; blocking is safe.

cloud_exposure.name: Cloud Data Exposure Response
cloud_exposure.description: Remediate an exposed cloud storage bucket and revoke compromised credentials.

steps.impact: S3 bucket ACL reverted to private. Public access blocked.
steps.risk: Low. May break public CDN links if any exist.

steps.impact: IAM access key deactivated. Services using this key will fail.
steps.risk: High if key is used by production automation. Verify before revoking.

steps.impact: Exfiltrating IP blocked at perimeter and WAF for 72 hours.
steps.risk: Low. IP is external unknown; blocking is appropriate.
